versions.changelog:
media-gen 1.0.0 brings unified image and video generation support for major AIsa models.

- Adds support for four image models (Gemini 3 Pro Image, Wan 2.7 image-image-pro, Seedream).
- Supports four Wan video models (wan2.6/2.7 t2v/i2v), with model-specific parameter routing.
- Bundled client script automatically routes requests to the correct endpoints based on model.
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md, with detailed API/curl examples and usage patterns.
- Centralizes all generation workflows with a single API key.

- Added support for both AI image and video generation through AIsa.
- Improved documentation with detailed usage scenarios, quick reference, and setup instructions.
- Clarified required environment variable (`AISA_API_KEY`).
- Enhanced guardrails to ensure accurate responses and proper handling of rate limits and local files.
- Expanded high-intent workflow examples for creative media generation.
